runtime.note: A single native binary. The host needs no .NET runtime. SQLite is bundled: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite carries the e_sqlite3 native lib, which the AOT publish emits beside the binary.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: the reactor re-reads the world through kgsm-lib before deciding whether a condition still holds

commands.name: python3
commands.why: deploy.sh's health probe reads the leaf_ready line out of this leaf's own journal, which bash parses badly
commands.without: the probe degrades to `systemctl is-active` and says so rather than claiming a stronger check

services.name: kgsm-watchdog.service
services.why: the watchdog is the producer of the crash, give-up and player events the reactor exists to observe
services.without: the reactor observes every other producer and simply never sees a fault, because nothing is emitting one

services.name: kgsm-monitor.service
services.without: no threshold observation is recorded — the reactor cannot measure a condition nobody reports

system.why: the reactor reads every producer's event journal, and a directory cannot be entered without execute on every directory above it
system.note: each producer's StateDirectoryMode is 0750 with Group=kgsm, so the reactor's service account has to be in that group.
